summary:
ZENITH — An intelligent space-health monitoring platform that transforms astronaut biomedical data into actionable insights and mission-ready telemetry.

The long-term vision is to provide a reliable connection between astronaut health systems and Earth-based mission control, improving medical awareness and decision-making during extended space missions.
details:
ZENITH — Peak Astronaut Health Monitoring

ZENITH is an astronaut health monitoring prototype designed for long-duration space missions. It brings crew health information into one dashboard so astronauts and mission teams can review readings and identify changes.

Problem

During a long mission, crew members may need to monitor health information from several sources while working with limited communication to Earth. A single overview could help the crew and ground team review that information more easily.

Proposed solution

ZENITH provides a mission dashboard with:

  • Crew overview: Individual profiles, health summaries and attention status.
  • Vital signs: Heart rate, blood oxygen, blood pressure and body temperature.
  • EEG and ECG: Visualizations of brain and heart signals using simulated data.
  • Sleep and exercise: Records for reviewing rest and physical activity.
  • Alerts and reports: A way to highlight readings that need attention and review summaries.
  • Device management: A concept for connecting future sensors through adapters.

How it works

  1. A mock generator produces synthetic crew health readings.
  2. The application displays the readings on the dashboard.
  3. The telemetry prototype can queue packets in browser storage.
  4. A development sync endpoint can validate and acknowledge packets.
  5. A future ground system could receive and display data sent through spacecraft communication hardware.

Technology used

Area

Technology

Frontend

React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS

Build tool

Vite

Local telemetry queue

Dexie and IndexedDB

Visualizations

SVG and HTML Canvas

Hosting

Vercel

Current status

The dark ZENITH frontend is deployed. Mock EEG and ECG telemetry changes have been prepared in a separate branch, but they are not yet connected to that dark frontend.

The health data is simulated. ZENITH does not currently transmit data through radio waves or provide a production backend, and it is not a medical device.

Future development

  • Connect the mock telemetry generator to the deployed dark frontend.
  • Add secure backend storage and a simulated ground receiver.
  • Test data handling during communication interruptions.
  • Explore integration with real sensors and radio hardware.
